description: AVIATION BATTLES ONLY (pick AVIATION on the main menu). Fighter jets for both sides. Vanguard flies the F/A-18E Super Hornet, F-16C Viper and A-10C Warthog; Onyx flies the Su-27 Flanker, MiG-29 Fulcrum and Su-25 Frogfoot. Pick a jet on the deploy screen and you start in the air. Steer with the mouse (or drag on a phone), or switch FLIGHT CONTROLS to JOYSTICK in the settings to fly with the stick or W/S/A/D (with an INVERT PITCH option). Throttle with afterburner, 1/2/3 weapons: cannon, heat-seeking missiles with lock-on, and bombs, rockets or guided missiles. Space drops flares, E ejects with a parachute. Bots fly them too: dogfights, strafing runs and bombing.
